basic_info.description: Presidio Laurel - rare luxury new construction in Presidio & Laurel Heights. Beautifully appointed new condominium homes with modern designer finishes including Taj Mahal stone counters, Riva White Oak flooring, EcoSmart fireplaces, Miele appliances, Leicht cabinetry, Waterworks fixtures, Carrara & French Limestone. 3651 California is a 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom home with  north, west and east-facing windows providing beautiful natural light to the open Living/ Dining/ Kitchen floor plan. Access to shared view roof terrace. Close to boutiques, restaurants, cafes, & Laurel Village. The 1491 acre Presidio National Park is 3 blocks north.  Secured Leased parking pre-paid on California Street.  PresidioLaurel.com.  Video Preview!
